audit_target_contract.presentation_claim: A helmeted skier wearing red goggles and a backpack holds a camera while standing on a snowy mountain ridge, with distant snow-covered peaks and blue sky in the background.

video_describe.brief_video_summary: A helmeted skier wearing red goggles and a backpack holds a camera while standing on a snowy mountain ridge, with distant snow-covered peaks and blue sky in the background.

items.what_to_verify: Do the helmet and goggles maintain consistent shape, position, and occlusion relative to the skier’s head across all frames?
items.anomaly_definition: An anomaly would be unexplained deformation, detachment, sliding, or inconsistent occlusion of the helmet or goggles relative to the head.
minimum_checks: Compare the helmet outline and strap placement across early, middle, and late frames.
Track the goggles relative to the helmet and visible facial features during head turns.
Inspect the helmet-to-head boundary for discontinuities or inconsistent occlusion.

target_entities: skier’s arm and hand holding camera
items.what_to_verify: Does the skier’s arm and hand maintain a consistent, physically plausible grip and orientation relative to the camera across all frames?
items.anomaly_definition: An anomaly would be an abrupt grip change, implausible joint configuration, detached hand, or inconsistent camera orientation relative to the arm.
minimum_checks: Track the hand-to-camera connection across the sequence.
Compare elbow and wrist positions during the skier's small posture changes.
Check that the camera remains oriented toward the skier's face as the arm moves.

items.what_to_verify: Whether the background mountain contours retain coherent geometry as the skier moves.
items.anomaly_definition: An anomaly would be unexplained warping, duplication, or discontinuous displacement of the distant mountain ridgelines.
minimum_checks: Compare prominent ridge peaks at the beginning, middle, and end of the clip.
Check that the ridgelines remain spatially coherent relative to the sky and foreground slope.

findings.observation: Helmet and goggles remain fixed in position and shape, with no warping, sliding, or inconsistent occlusion relative to the head.
Hand remains in a stable, continuous grip on the camera; arm angle and position change smoothly with body movement.
The distant mountain ridgelines retain consistent contours and relative placement throughout the clip.

evidence_assessment.reason: Helmet and goggles remain fixed in position and shape, with no warping, sliding, or inconsistent occlusion relative to the head.
Hand remains in a stable, continuous grip on the camera; arm angle and position change smoothly with body movement.
The distant mountain ridgelines retain consistent contours and relative placement throughout the clip.

audit.aggregation: Other inspected observations: Helmet and goggles remain fixed in position and shape, with no warping, sliding, or inconsistent occlusion relative to the head. Hand remains in a stable, continuous grip on the camera; arm angle and position change smoothly with body movement. The distant mountain ridgelines retain consistent contours and relative placement throughout the clip.
